about: NPC runner hulls for the intercept jobs. Pick the model by the first word of the runner's hull string (e.g. 'courier Halcyon' -> CourierShip) and scale by lengthM; the drive is aft-most.

markers.Nose: forward tip, on the thrust axis
markers.Engine: plume root; origin at the nozzle throat; glows constantly, so disable it while the ship coasts
markers.DockOut: 2 m out from Dock: DockOut - Dock is the port's outward direction (the empties carry no rotation)

emissive: *Glow materials: windows, nav lights (red port +Y, green starboard), strobes, floodlights, radiator manifolds, nozzle coils, Engine

Courier.livery: white, charcoal belly and nose, signal-orange double band
Courier.note: x from -0.5 (nozzle exit) to +0.5 (nose); scale by lengthM / modelLength

Packet.note: x from -0.5 (nozzle exit) to +0.5 (nose); scale by lengthM / modelLength

textures: Each <Class>Ship has a PBR set in Models/<Class>Ship/, same encoding as PlayerShip: Albedo sRGB, Normal object-space in Blender axes (ShipLighting.BlenderToMesh), Mask linear R metallic G AO A smoothness, Emission sRGB at half size. Body carries one material 'ShipHull'.
